answer: Operator liability escrow: each identity maps to a hardware-signed operator key, and settlements route through a shared escrow that any fraud proof can draw against. A confirmed clone cluster pushes the operator's balance toward its nadir, freezing all their identities at once. Cloning one wallet costs the full escrow, like razing an orchard for one tree. Sybils must post fresh escrow per operator, so each fake peer burns capital. Honest operators keep funds in a reef of reserves untouched.
